review_candidates.description: Position: Sr. Project Engineer, high-voltage transmission infrastructure Location: Greater Chicago OR Sacramento area Reports to: Managing Director of Engineering & Construction Company: Private equity-backed operator of high-voltage transmission infrastructure Chamberlain Advisors is conducting an executive search for a Senior Project Engineer on behalf of our direct client, a scaling private equity-backed operator of high-voltage transmission infrastructure. As an integral member of the Engineering & Construction team, this individual will lead and manage the design of assigned high-voltage transmission line and/or substation projects from conception through construction and energization. This role is vital for winning competitive FERC Order 1000 bids and ensuring efficient project construction. They are seeking an individual with a balance of Project Management skills and technical competency in either transmission line or substation engineering disciplines, or ideally both, demonstrating experience in full life cycle management of high voltage (>100kV) transmission facility projects. The ideal candidate will have a bias for action, proven analytical and problem-solving skills, while ensuring project commercial and technical targets are met or exceeded. The ideal candidate must be technically astute, collaborative, and possess a strong entrepreneurial spirit, willing to adapt and lead in a fast-paced, highly interactive team setting to deliver successful outcomes. This is an extraordinary opportunity for an engineering leader to provide strategic technical and project leadership in a dynamic, high-growth environment. With a strong continuous improvement mindset and a hands-on approach, they excel at driving rapid, effective results. A self-starter, the candidate is comfortable transitioning from high-level strategy to day-to-day operations, digging into the details when necessary. Motivated by the opportunity to be autonomous, lead transformative change, they are energized by solving visible, impactful problems and working in a lean, private equity-backed environment. This individual is gritty, willing to get their hands dirty, and committed to building and growing the company’s success, without relying heavily on extensive support layers. High-voltage Technical Design & Engineering Expertise: This encompasses deep knowledge and hands-on experience in either transmission line or substation design, specifically at high-voltages (100 kV as a floor, ideally 230 kV or 345 kV and above). The candidate must demonstrate proficiency in utilizing industry-standard design tools prevalent within the high-voltage transmission sector, including but not limited to PLS-CADD, SAG10, AutoCAD, or other similar tools. The ideal candidate will have been accountable for the entire design lifecycle, leading the project and bringing all elements together, beyond siloed tasks such as electrical studies. You will have navigated the complexities of greenfield transmission line projects including routing through diverse terrains, securing environmental permits, and optimizing cost-efficiency. Experience with complex elements like underground transmission, mountainous terrain, or HVDC (LCC or VSC) is a strong plus. FERC Order 1000 Proposals: You will lead the technical engineering effort for competitive FERC Order 1000 RFPs, strategically developing and evaluating solutions for cost-effectiveness across various ISO requirements. This includes creating comprehensive engineering deliverables and advocating for your proposed solutions to stakeholders. Your strong understanding and application of quality review processes for all engineering documentation are essential. Given the fast-paced and iterative nature of these proposals, you must be comfortable with constant team interaction, frequent meetings, and adapting quickly to changes and rework. While direct FERC Order 1000 experience is beneficial, a proven track record in any complex proposal or bid response is sufficient. Strategic Third-Party Management & Diverse Project Leadership: You are adept at effectively managing, influencing, and driving accountability through external consulting firms, guiding and partnering with them to achieve project success by fostering truly collaborative relationships. Your technical expertise must be at least equivalent to that of the consultants you manage, enabling you to ask informed questions and keep project processes on track. We seek a technical project engineer who can also perform holistic project management, taking accountability for schedule, cost aspects/budgets, and assembling/reviewing inputs for estimates, as well as the oversight/technical management of schedules, timelines, and work of your consultants/teams. Multi-Stakeholder Management & Collaborative Leadership: You excel at managing and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including third-party engineering consultants, construction partners, OEMs, and regulatory bodies. Your approach fosters strong, productive partnerships, ensuring all parties are aligned with project goals and deliverables. You are adept at guiding and empowering external partners, leveraging your technical insight to ensure work aligns with scope, budget, and quality standards. This includes the ability to convey complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders and management, facilitating clear communication and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.. What You Will Be Accountable For Proposal Phase (Winning Projects): Work within the Engineering team to ensure designs are aligned with the overall proposal strategy of their Development Group. Projects generally begin as FERC 1,000 competitive transmission project proposals but may also involve acquisitions of existing utility assets Lead the technical engineering effort to support competitive proposal teams, specifically focusing on responses to FERC Order 1000 RFPs. This includes navigating the unique requirements of various ISOs (e.g., CAISO, NYISO, MISO, PJM). Competitively bid and secure engineering and third-party consulting resources required to adequately support the development team’s proposal efforts and RFP specific requirements. Manage and guide third-party engineering consultants, ensuring their work aligns with project scope, budget, and quality standards, and strategically determining necessary reports (e.g., desk study & preliminary geotechnical assessments) to optimize proposal development. Directly supervise the selected consultant in developing conceptual designs (design criteria and related design documentation) that will form the basis of the development team’s proposal and project estimate, providing guidance and feedback on designs within a competitive transmission framework. Lead the coordination with OEM (HVDC systems, HVAC equipment, conductors, cables, etc.) and ensure the technical and commercial requirements are in line with project requirements and internal strategy expectations. Rapidly screen and evaluate diverse technical solutions for cost-effectiveness, applying strong engineering judgment to identify the most viable and competitive options. Develop comprehensive engineering deliverables for proposals, such as preliminary structural drawings, detailed electrical studies, and foundation designs. Prepare robust estimating packages to facilitate collaboration with external construction partners, ensuring alignment between design and cost projections. Manage all contracted resources to meet deliverable dates and complete tasks within budget. Adapt quickly to iterative changes and tight deadlines inherent in competitive bidding processes, which often compress traditional engineering phases into shorter, parallel workflows. Act as a technical advocate during proposal phase, articulating the value and superiority of their proposed solutions to regulatory bodies and stakeholders. Execution Phase (Completing Construction Projects) Following award of a project, develop RFP and technical scope documents for all procurement related to engineering and constructing the awarded project (e.g., engineering consulting services, 3rd party services, high voltage equipment, transmission line structures and materials, construction contracts, etc.). Lead the bid evaluation process for both technical and commercial aspects of supplier’s proposal. Take full accountability for both the project management and technical aspects of projects, including managing scope, schedule, and budget. This includes the ability to convey complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders and management. Provide ongoing management and guidance to external engineering consultants throughout the project lifecycle, serving as the primary technical interface and ensuring their deliverables meet specifications and timelines. Develop, review, and approve engineering deliverables (drawings, specifications, BOMs, design reports), ensuring all work complies with applicable codes, standards, safety, and operating requirements. Implement and champion robust quality review processes for all engineering documentation and drawings, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to industry standards and best practices. Perform technical risk assessments and actively resolve design challenges in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Closely coordinate with other project stakeholders to identify and develop a transmission line route and/or substation site and provide technical inputs to obtain permits necessary to design and develop the project. Oversee the engineering and technical integrity of awarded projects, ensuring designs are accurately translated into constructible plans. Manage project progress comprehensively, from initial design through construction oversight, commissioning, and ultimately, hand-off to operations and maintenance. Coordinate with other groups inside and outside of the company to ensure the projects are successful and aligned with their strategic business objectives. Generally responsible for providing a single E&C project point of contact and owner’s engineer for both internal and external personnel and groups on assigned projects, including presentations/briefing on current progress (e.g. technical, cost, schedule), issues, procurement concerns/strategy, construction planning, and risk mitigation in meetings with other company personnel. Minimum 7 years direct experience in high-voltage (>100kV) transmission line (>5 Miles) or substation project development, design, engineering, and construction. Ideally 2+ years' experience developing designs for FERC Order 1000 proposals, or broader experience in competitive bid/proposal work. Proficient using an industry-standard transmission design software such as (PLS-CADD, SAG10), and/or electric substation design tools such as (AutoCAD Electrical, Bentley’s Open Utilities Substation). review_candidates.description: We have a full marketing production team. Content, design, web, video, product marketing. We have a sales team sitting ready to take meetings. What we don't have is anyone whose entire job is filling the funnel. So the pipeline gets built the hard way, one cold call at a time, while the inbound machine that should be feeding it doesn't exist yet. We want one person to build it, own it, and be measured on what comes out of the end: qualified demos landing in the sales team's calendar. This isn't a run-some-ads role. You'll own the whole journey, from people who've never heard of us, through people who know the name, all the way to a booked meeting. Paid, events, webinars, trade media, conversion, the handoff to sales, the budget and every number in between. If you've built a demand gen engine before and want to do it again somewhere it will actually make the difference, keep reading. Read on! (this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying) _________________________________________________________________________________________ We are Shape.Construction! We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it). We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 4 core values for a good life We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself Care about people – Your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version! We enshrined our values in our vision We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _________________________________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role Shape has a full marketing production team (content, design, web, video, product marketing) and a sales team ready to take meetings. What we don't have is someone whose entire job is filling the funnel. You'll own one number, qualified demos booked for the sales team, and everything that feeds it. This isn't a run-some-ads role. You'll build and own the complete journey from cold audiences who've never heard of us, through "Shape Aware" (people who've engaged with the brand: visited the website, engaged with content or ads), all the way to a booked demo. You own the funnel, the numbers at every stage of it, and how those leads land with the sales team. Team You'll sit in Shape's marketing team and your leader will be the Head of Marketing. You'll work daily with the SDR and sales teams, who receive everything you generate. The team already has content, design, web, video and product marketing covered, so you won't be writing the copy or building the pages yourself. You'll brief and direct that output toward campaigns. You'll also work alongside our GTM Engineer, who owns the data and signals layer you'll use to target the right accounts at the right time. What's missing is someone pointing all of that at a number. That's you. Your top six objectives Own inbound lead generation end to end, with qualified demos booked for the sales team as your core KPI. Build a full funnel we can see into at every stage, from cold audiences through Shape Aware to booked demo. Run paid as your fastest route to volume: advertising is your primary engine. Build events, webinars, trade media and syndication into a second engine, so we're not dependent on ad spend alone. Own conversion and the handoff, so no lead ever goes stale in a form somewhere. Own the budget: recommend what spend is needed to hit the number, then justify, track and report on it. Your Top Six Responsibilities Your remit splits into two activity streams, Paid and Events, and you decide the right mix between them based on what's actually producing demos. Beyond those two, you own the full channel mix. If you see an opportunity in SEO, partnerships, referral, PR or review sites that gets us to the number faster, that's yours to pursue too. Advertising. LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Reddit, Insta and any other channel worth running, both cold acquisition and retargeting to warm Shape Aware audiences. Paid media and syndication. Trade publications and industry media placements that put us in front of the right audience. Events coordination. Choosing and running the industry events and conferences worth being at, from planning through to the follow-up that turns attendees into demos. Webinars, in two formats. One-to-many webinars on product demos and industry topics for top and mid-funnel, building the Shape Aware audience and warming people up. And one-to-few "lunch and learn" style sessions for a small group of target accounts at the bottom of the funnel, run in support of sales to help move specific deals forward. Funnel, conversion and handoff. Build and report on funnel-stage metrics, not just the demo number: how many people are Shape Aware, how they move between stages, where they drop off and what it costs to move them. Own conversion, so landing pages, forms and follow-up journeys, testing and iterating relentlessly. Own the handoff, so when a demo is booked you define how the sales team is notified, what context they get and how fast it happens. Budget, briefing and lead quality. Must-Have (The fundamentals) Mastery: A track record building full-funnel B2B demand generation, not just managing ad spend. You will show how you took cold audiences through to booked meetings and the numbers at each stage. Hands-on paid media experience (LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads as a minimum) and a strong grasp of conversion optimisation across landing pages, forms and follow-up journeys. Ideally some experience with events, webinars or trade media as lead sources. HubSpot experience a strong plus. Communication: Proficient communicator in written and verbal English. Able to brief and direct creative teams without doing the design or copy yourself, and to report honestly upward on what's working and what isn't. Leadership: Strong critical thinking. You work out why something isn't converting and fix the right problem, rather than turning dials and hoping. You're comfortable owning a number and being measured on it, and you lead yourself proactively. Impact: AI-native in how you work. You use AI (we run on Claude, including Claude Cowork) to handle the admin, reporting and grunt work so your time goes on strategy and optimisation. Nice to Have (If you don't have it now you will after joining) Mastery: Marketing automation and nurture design in HubSpot, account-based marketing into named accounts, SEO and organic as a lead source, and construction or built-environment industry knowledge (a bonus, not a requirement). Communication: The confidence to influence a sales team on lead quality and definitions, rather than just handing leads over and hoping. Leadership: Experience being the first demand gen hire somewhere, building the function from nothing rather than inheriting one. Impact: A repeatable playbook you've run more than once, at more than one company, with the numbers to show it worked both times. Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true: You want an easy role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team You'd rather report on activity than be measured on an outcome _________________________________________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions Can you tell me more about what the role is like? We are in scale up mode so it will be a full-on role with more things to do than time available. This is why it will be important to prioritise ruthlessly. We don't like to mess about so you will need to be a very high performer who only wants to work with others of your ilk. This role is unusually clear about what success means, because it comes down to one number. That's a good thing if you like owning an outcome and having the autonomy to decide how you hit it. We are growing rapidly so that means your role will grow rapidly too. You will need to keep up and constantly be looking 1-2 years ahead. What does success look like? Within 3 months: a measurable funnel we can see into at every stage. How many people are Shape Aware, what it costs to create them, how they convert, and a predictable flow of demos landing with sales, with the team notified instantly and properly every time one books. As for a tangible target, you are generating 30 qualified demos a month via inbound activity, with the months leading up showing a clearly defined path to that number and significant, visible improvement week on week. Realistically we expect paid to be the fastest route there, but how you hit the number is your call. Beyond that, we want events and webinars contributing properly so the number keeps growing and we aren't dependent on ad spend alone. What have you already got in place? A full production team for content, design, web and video, so you have people to build what you brief. HubSpot as our CRM and marketing platform. review_candidates.description: What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements. We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future. How you’ll demonstrate Ownership At Cognite, we're transforming the world's most asset-intensive industries through Industrial AI. Our customers rely on us to turn complex industrial data into meaningful business outcomes—and this is where you come in. We're looking for a Project Manager who enjoys solving complex challenges, takes ownership of outcomes, and is motivated by delivering measurable value. This role goes beyond managing timelines; you'll lead transformational AI implementation projects that help some of the world's largest industrial organisations modernise the way they operate. From contract signing through deployment and value realisation, you'll partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver successful projects that create lasting business impact. The Impact you bring to Cognite As the Project Manager, you'll be accountable for the successful delivery of complex Industrial AI implementation projects by: Leading end-to-end project delivery from kickoff through deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Owning project scope, schedule, budget, quality, customer outcomes, and commercial performance. Collaborating with Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality solutions. Translating customer objectives into measurable success metrics and facilitating Value Realisation Workshops to demonstrate business impact. Managing project financials, including forecasting, revenue recognition, profitability, cost management, and reporting. Building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, and providing clear communication throughout the project lifecycle. Identifying and managing risks, dependencies, and scope changes while ensuring appropriate governance and transparency. Supporting customer adoption through change management, enablement, and training while recognising opportunities to expand customer value. Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices by applying Cognite's PMO methodologies, playbooks, and lessons learned. Required Qualifications A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years of experience delivering complex software, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology implementation projects. Experience managing enterprise or industrial digital transformation programmes involving multiple stakeholders and technical workstreams. Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architecture, and enterprise systems, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams and informed decision-making. Strong commercial and financial acumen, including forecasting, revenue recognition, margin management, and project profitability. Experience within one or more industrial sectors, including Energy, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Utilities, Power & Renewables, or Life Sciences. Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and project governance frameworks such as Scrum, PMP, or PRINCE2. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently across technical teams, customers, and executive stakeholders. Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet. Willingness to travel up to 25% as required. Preferred Skills We're particularly interested if you also bring experience in: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification. Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Industrial IoT, SCADA, MES, or Operational Technology (OT) environments. AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, or Analytics implementation projects. Why Cognite? At Cognite, you'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve complex, real-world challenges. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-moving environment where innovation, curiosity, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value diverse perspectives and believe great ideas come from people with different experiences and backgrounds. If you're excited by technology, enjoy working with customers to solve meaningful problems, and want to help shape the future of industry, we'd love to hear from you. Learn More About Us Impact 2025 Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi. Equal Opportunity Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.
